pages.title: [Conversation: <session title>]
pages.purpose: The conversation with one session: streaming transcript, composer with attachments/commands/voice, pending sends, attention requests and all session actions.

reachedFrom.trigger: named route '/chat/<sessionID>' resolved in onGenerateRoute (lib/main.dart:1247); ChatRouteArguments.discardIfUntouched marks a newly created session
session launch (SessionLaunch, e.g. notification tap): _OcAppState._openSessionForLaunch pushes '/chat/<id>' (lib/main.dart:635)
deep link to a session: _OcAppState._openSessionForLink pushNamed '/chat/<id>' (lib/main.dart:783, 796)
new-session app shortcut / home onNewSession: _OcAppState._startNewSession pushes '/chat/<id>' (lib/main.dart:1062, invoked at 1099 and 1202)

first run: HomeScreen._openFirstConversation pushes '/chat/<id>' with ChatRouteArguments.firstRun() after the first connect of a new device (lib/ui/screens/home_screen.dart:173); focusComposer opens the keyboard

gates: no capability gate on the screen itself; reached by route '/chat/<id>' or a direct ChatScreen(...) push
widget.showAppBar (default true): an embedding experience (demo) can hide the app bar
most authoring features are disabled when _conn.isIsolated

elements.label: Undo
elements.effect: SnackBarAction on the 'Draft text cleared' snackbar shown by _clearDraftText(): restores the cleared composer text (prepending it to anything typed since), calls _persistDraft() and refocuses the composer.
gates: shown only after _clearDraftText() ran (composer onClearText, wired at line 7209)
_clearDraftText is a no-op while _promptShelfBusy

elements.label: Load older messages | Retry | Reload recent history
elements.effect: Calls _loadOlder(): fetches the previous history page using _olderCursor (or reloads recent history when _olderNeedsReload) and merges it while keeping the scroll anchor. Label is 'Reload recent history' when _olderNeedsReload, 'Retry' when _olderError != null, else 'Load older messages'.
gates: row (_olderHistoryRow, key 'chat-older-history') is returned from the transcript item builder at line 6689
disabled while _loading || _loadingOlder (a spinner overlays the label)

elements.label: Arrow Up / Arrow Down in composer
elements.effect: _focus.onKeyEvent -> _navigatePromptHistory (line 893): with the caret at the start (Up) or end (Down), replaces the composer value with the previous/next entry of _recentPrompts via PromptHistoryNavigation.move, retaining the original draft for restore.
gates: !_conn.isIsolated
!_sending && !_promptShelfBusy
isPromptHistoryKey(...): no slash-command or @agent suggestions open, collapsed selection, no IME composing, no Ctrl/Alt/Meta/Shift held

pages.title: Some attachments need attention
pages.purpose: Asks whether to continue with only the recoverable saved draft attachments when some are missing, unreadable or belong to another project.

reachedFrom.trigger: automatic from initState (line 570) when the saved session draft has attachments and _conn.restoreDraftAttachments reports unavailable files; re-run by _retryDraftPersistence (draft-failure retry callback wired at line 7111)

gates: !_conn.isIsolated
recovered.unavailable.isNotEmpty
_draftLocation == _conn.locationRevision

elements.label: Use available attachments
elements.effect: Replaces _attachments with recovered.attachments, clears _draftRecoveryBlocked and _draftSaveFailure and schedules _persistDraft(), which drops the unavailable attachments from the saved draft (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Keep saved draft
elements.effect: Keeps the stored draft snapshot untouched; _draftRecoveryBlocked stays true and _draftSaveFailure becomes SessionDraftFailure.attachments (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Some attachments cannot be restored
pages.purpose: Warns that some attachments of the chosen stashed prompt are missing before restoring the rest.
gates: _conn.canUsePromptShelf
_conn.restorePromptStashAttachments(...).unavailable.isNotEmpty
composer unchanged since the stash sheet opened

elements.label: Restore available content
elements.effect: Continues _openPromptStash(): after the optional restore confirmation, puts the stashed text, recovered attachments and references into the composer and keeps the stash copy (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Aborts the restore; composer and stash unchanged (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Restore saved prompt?
pages.purpose: Confirms replacing a non-empty composer with a stashed prompt; the current prompt is stashed first.
gates: _conn.canUsePromptShelf
current composer snapshot is not empty (!current.isEmpty)

elements.label: Restore
elements.effect: Saves the current prompt with _conn.savePromptStash(current) (refused with a 'stash full' note at PromptShelfStore.capacity), replaces composer text, attachments and staged references with the selected entry, _persistDraft(), then _conn.removePromptStash(selected.id) unless a copy must be kept (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Aborts the restore; composer and stash unchanged (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Discard queued draft?
pages.purpose: Confirms discarding an offline-queued prompt; wording changes when the draft's earlier send was never confirmed.
gates: queued drafts exist for this session (_conn.capabilities.offlinePromptQueue)
asked a second time when the draft got dispatched while the first sheet was open (line 2302)

elements.label: Discard draft
elements.effect: _discardQueuedPrompt() re-reads the live entry and calls _removeQueuedDraft(id) -> _conn.removeQueuedPrompt(id) (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Keep it queued | Keep for review (when asked.dispatched)
elements.effect: Keeps the queued draft (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Send this draft again?
pages.purpose: Confirms resending a queued draft whose earlier send was never confirmed (it may duplicate).
gates: queued draft is in review (dispatched but unconfirmed)

elements.label: Send again
elements.effect: Calls _conn.resendQueuedPrompt(entry.id), clearing the dispatch marker so the draft is sent again; a storage failure shows queueSaveFailed (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Keep for review
elements.effect: Keeps the draft in review (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Cancel this pending message?
pages.purpose: Confirms cancelling a pending server-side inbox message; its text returns to the composer.
gates: a pending Api2InboxItem exists for the session (_conn.supportsInbox)

elements.label: Cancel message
elements.effect: Calls _conn.cancelInboxItem(sessionID, item.id); the returned text is prepended to the composer and focused; HTTP 409 shows the 'already delivered' snackbar (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Keep it pending
elements.effect: Keeps the pending message (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Pending photo
pages.purpose: Shown before picking a new photo when another photo is still pending in its original conversation.
gates: !_conn.isIsolated && _conn.capabilities.promptAttachments
platformCapabilities.supportsPromptPhotos
_conn.promptPhotos.pending != null
attachment count (5) and aggregate size (20 MB) limits not reached

elements.label: Discard pending photo
elements.effect: Calls _conn.promptPhotos.discard(pending.id), then persists the draft and continues to _conn.promptPhotos.pick(source: gallery|camera) and _applyPendingPhoto() (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Keep editing
elements.effect: Keeps the pending photo and aborts picking (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).

pages.title: Share this session?
pages.purpose: Warns that anyone with the link can view the session before creating a public share link.
gates: _shareUrl == null at the command entry point (otherwise it calls _stopSharing)

elements.label: Share session
elements.effect: Calls repository.shareSession(sessionID) via _requireActionRepository(), stores _localShareUrl, _conn.refreshSessions(), copies the URL with Clipboard.setData and shows a 'share link copied' snackbar (FilledButton rendered by showConfirmSheet in lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart; pops true).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Closes without sharing (cancel button of showConfirmSheet; pops false).
